description: This file defines a PHP class ModuleListProvider within the Api\V8\Helper namespace. The class provides methods for retrieving and processing a list of modules accessible to the current user in the SuiteCRM system, including filtering by visibility, accessibility, and adding labels. It interacts with global variables and other classes to determine access rights and module information.

classes.name: ModuleListProvider
classes.description: A helper class for retrieving and processing the list of modules accessible to the current user, including filtering, labeling, and access control logic.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modules accessible to the current user, filtering out invisible modules, adding ACL-based access information, and labels.

methods.name: addModuleLabels
methods.description: Adds human-readable labels to each module in the list using the global $app_list_strings array.

methods.name: removeInvisibleModules
methods.description: Removes modules from the list that are marked as invisible in the global $modInvisList.

methods.name: markACLAccess
methods.description: Marks modules with their ACL access rights for the current user, producing a list with access control information.

methods.name: buildAccessArray
methods.description: Builds an array of actions for a module where the user has the required ACL permissions.

methods.name: hasACL
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has ACL permissions to access a module based on the ACL level.
